title: Live DOM autostereogram
blurb: A live editable HTML form whose contrast drives a GPU single-image random-dot autostereogram on one WebGL 2 canvas, with cross-eye stereo pair, red/cyan anaglyph, wiggle 3D and depth overlay modes while the input and buttons stay clickable.
question: Can a live editable HTML form's contrast and element geometry drive a real-time GPU single-image random-dot autostereogram so typed letters and clickable buttons emerge in hidden 3D depth while staying directly interactive?
result: Not verified in a live browser yet. One ElementGL WebGL 2 context uploads the live form with texElementSubImage2D(), traces the exact horizontal strip chain in a single fragment pass with zero readback, renders five stereo viewing modes and keeps controls interactive via updateElementGeometry() scaled by geometryUnit().
